entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: Priest of the Kjeldoran village of Mikkel during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Orphan taken in by Halvor, bearing the mark of the Elder Druid; left for Fyndhorn with Kolbjörn.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: Elder Druid who came to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Traveler who fought the undead at the church.

entities.name: Klazina Jansdotter
entities.description: Traveler who fought the undead at the church.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: Traveler who helped fight the undead.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Knight of the Order of Stromgald who allied with Lim-Dul and became undead.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Goddess whose song Kolbjörn and Kaysa chanted.

entities.name: Mikkel
entities.description: Kjeldoran village where Halvor was priest.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Forest where Kolbjörn lived with elves.

events.summary: A great storm kept Mikkel's inhabitants from Krov; only Halvor and Kaysa reached the church for the Feast of Kjeld.
events.quote: Only Halvor and Kaysa reached the local church, intending to celebrate the feast anyway.

events.summary: Kolbjörn announced he had come to take Kaysa; Halvor refused.
events.quote: When Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa, who bore the mark of the Elder Druid, with him

events.summary: Avram revealed he had allied with Lim-Dul and become undead.
events.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead

events.summary: Kolbjörn and Kaysa chanted the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of their life and saving the group.
events.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

events.summary: Halvor agreed to let Kaysa go to Fyndhorn with Kolbjörn.
events.quote: Halvor, admitting the miracle he witnessed the night before, agreed to let them go.

relations.quote: Halvor took in the orphaned Kaysa as a ward of the church and his assistant.
